\section*{Data and code availability}

The search configurations and exports, screening and charting outputs, the operation library (version 1.3.0), the analysis code and the source data of every figure panel are available at https://github.com/BogdanDidenko/text-bio-fundational-models-review (this version: commit a4f1a390). \nolinkurl{manuscript/supplementary/README.md} gives the repository path of every supplementary item, and the earlier version of this manuscript, with its internal labels, is \nolinkurl{manuscript/archive/review_manuscript_draft_v0.5.1.md} (commit 4c4db9f0). The component library is browsable at https://bogdandidenko.github.io/text-bio-fundational-models-review/component-library/. A curated snapshot of the repository and the protocol with its amendments are deposited on Zenodo \todo{DOIs}. The run logs of the LLM agents embed the texts of the papers and are not part of the snapshot; the prompts of the screening roles are reproduced in Supplementary Note S3, and the decisions of the agents for every record are in the supplementary data files.
